description: Implement the 5 lower-complexity pages: NotificationsPage (list + mark read/mark all), UserManagementPage (pending approvals + all users table with approve/reject/suspend), AuditLogPage (filterable paginated audit table), ProfilePage (info card + RHF edit form via apiClient.put /auth/me), and HelpPage (fully static: demo credentials, roles, walkthrough). Independent of FEAT-001 — no shared code between the groups. Done after FEAT-001 so the final convergence build covers all 9 pages together.
steps: Read d:\SIH NEW PROJECT\frontend\.agents\tasks\context.json and d:\SIH NEW PROJECT\frontend\.agents\tasks\plan.md FIRST (do not re-explore — plan.md has verbatim signatures and a Deviations section correcting wrong assumptions). All paths below are relative to d:\SIH NEW PROJECT\frontend (worktree).

Implement src/pages/notifications/NotificationsPage.tsx per plan.md PAGE 3: useQuery listNotifications({limit:100}) -> use .items; useQueryClient. PageHeader 'Notifications' with a 'Mark All Read' action button (markAllRead() useMutation -> toast.success + invalidate ['notifications']). List each notification as a div: unread bg-indigo-50 border-indigo-200, read bg-white border-gray-200; title font-semibold when unread; message; timestamp format(new Date(created_at),'dd MMM yyyy HH:mm'); priority Badge (map high/urgent/critical->red, medium->orange, low->gray, else blue); 'Mark as Read' button only when !is_read -> markRead(id) useMutation -> invalidate. Loading: 3x SkeletonCard. Empty: EmptyState 'No notifications yet'. DataNote banner.

Implement src/pages/admin/UserManagementPage.tsx per plan.md PAGE 6: PageHeader 'User Management'; useQuery listUsers({limit:200}) -> .items (User[]). Section 1 Pending Approvals: filter u.account_status === AccountStatus.pending_approval (NOT 'pending'); if count>0 amber banner 'X accounts pending approval'; table Name/Email/Designation/Role badge/Requested At(created_at)/Actions -> Approve (approveUser(id) useMutation -> toast 'Account approved' + invalidate) and Reject (rejectUser(id) useMutation -> toast 'Account rejected' + invalidate). Section 2 All Users: table Name/Email/Role badge (roleColor map: system_admin=red, senior_management=purple, bureau_officer=blue, regional_officer=indigo, data_admin=orange, coordination_reviewer=green)/Bureau ID/Status badge (active=green, pending_approval=yellow, suspended=red, rejected=gray)/Active check-or-cross/Suspend button only if is_active (suspendUser(id) useMutation -> toast + invalidate). Loading: TableSkeleton. Error: ErrorState with onRetry=refetch. Empty: EmptyState. Note u.role is UserRole (=string) -> roleColor(u.role); account_status is AccountStatus -> statusColor(u.account_status).

Implement src/pages/admin/AuditLogPage.tsx per plan.md PAGE 7: PageHeader 'Audit Log'; useQuery listAudit({skip,limit:50}) (action filter optional) -> .items + .total. Filter Select with options all/case_created/status_changed/case_assigned/coordination_created/coordination_closed/import_committed (reset skip to 0 on change). Table columns: Timestamp format dd MMM yyyy HH:mm / User (user?.full_name ?? 'User #'+user_id ?? '—') / Action (monospace) / Resource Type / Resource ID (?? '—') / Description (detail is Record<string,unknown> -> JSON.stringify(detail) ?? '—'). Pagination with skip state, limit=50, total from response. Loading: TableSkeleton. Error: ErrorState. Empty: EmptyState. DataNote.

Implement src/pages/profile/ProfilePage.tsx per plan.md PAGE 8: useAuth() user (nullable -> guard with ?.). PageHeader 'My Profile'; DataNote. Info Card: name, email, role Badge (roleColor), designation, bureau_id, account_status Badge (statusColor), last_login (User type has NO last_login field -> render '—', do NOT reference it). Edit form react-hook-form (full_name required, designation optional, defaultValues from user): onSubmit apiClient.put('/auth/me', {full_name, designation}) from src/api/client -> toast.success 'Profile updated' (catch -> toast.error); submit button loading state. Change Password Card: static note 'Contact your system administrator to change your password.' Pass user?.role ?? '' and user?.account_status to color helpers to satisfy string params.

Implement src/pages/help/HelpPage.tsx per plan.md PAGE 9: fully static, no API/queries, no useAuth (this is a PUBLIC route outside AppLayout). PageHeader 'Help & Information' (works standalone). Amber warning card. Demo Credentials Card with a table (Role/Email/Password): System Admin admin@aicte.demo Admin@123456; Bureau Officer officer1@aicte.demo Demo@123456; Coord. Reviewer reviewer@aicte.demo Demo@123456; Senior Management management@aicte.demo Demo@123456; Data Admin datamgr@aicte.demo Demo@123456; Regional Officer regional@aicte.demo Demo@123456. User Roles Card (Role/Description/Key Actions table). What's Implemented Card (CheckCircle bulleted ul). Limitations Card (XCircle bulleted ul). SIH Demo Walkthrough (5-7 min) Card with the exact 7 numbered steps from plan.md PAGE 9.

Run cd "d:\SIH NEW PROJECT\frontend" && npm run build and fix ALL TypeScript errors using the common-fix checklist in plan.md section 3. Repeat until exit code 0 with no TS errors and dist/ is emitted. This build now covers all 9 pages (FEAT-001's 4 + FEAT-002's 5) together.
Set FEAT-002 status to completed and record any findings the convergence step needs. Commit locally on the branch; never push.
acceptance_criteria: NotificationsPage lists notifications with read/unread styling, per-notification Mark as Read, and a working Mark All Read action.
UserManagementPage shows a pending-approvals section (filtered by AccountStatus.pending_approval) and an all-users table with working Approve/Reject/Suspend actions and role/status badges.
AuditLogPage renders a filterable, paginated audit table (50 per page) and the Description column safely renders the object detail field.
ProfilePage shows the user info card and a working edit form that PUTs to /auth/me; HelpPage has the demo-credentials table and 7-step walkthrough.
`cd "d:\SIH NEW PROJECT\frontend" && npm run build` exits 0 with zero TypeScript errors with all 9 pages implemented.
verification: cd "d:\SIH NEW PROJECT\frontend" && npm run build  (must exit 0, no TS errors, dist/ emitted — this build includes all 9 pages)
Confirm no stub default-export h1 remains in any of the 5 files (they contain real imports + queries/static JSX).
findings: All 5 pages implemented cleanly. tsc -b produced zero errors. Vite built dist/ in 7.82s with 2674 modules transformed. Key notes: AccountStatus.pending_approval filter works correctly; AuditEvent.detail rendered via JSON.stringify; User has no last_login field (rendered as dash); HelpPage is fully static with no useAuth. Build covers all 9 pages together (FEAT-001 + FEAT-002).
